rationale: Greek loanword δόγμα. In this passage the rival ⲁⲟⲅⲙⲁ are the philosophical-religious schools whose single-earth interpretation of the two-trees parable Mani critiques. 'Doctrine' preserves the technical sense of an established teaching-system.
Greek loanwords ἑρμηνεύω / ἑρμηνεία. Standard hermeneutic vocabulary; appears repeatedly in this kephalaion as the technical term for exegesis of the two-trees parable.
Coptic ⲃⲛⲛⲉ 'date, date-palm' (cognate with Sahidic ⲃⲛ̄ⲛⲉ). Functions here as exemplar tree in the discussion of the parable.
Coptic ϣⲁⲩ 'be useful, be of value' with verbal prefix ⲣ̄-. Combined with ⲍⲟⲗⲟⲧⲉⲗⲱⲥ ('wholly') and the negation ⲉⲛ, gives 'is not at all of comparable worth.'
Greek loanword ὁλοτελῶς. Adverbial intensifier; here functions in negated clause as 'not at all.'

Standard Manichaean Christological title applied also to Mani as Paraclete-apostle. Lycopolitan reflex of ⲡⲉⲭⲣⲓⲥⲧⲟⲥ, contracted form. 'The Anointed' preserves the verbal-participial root better than transliteration 'Christ.'
